description: This file defines the RouteRunner class within the Slim framework, responsible for handling HTTP requests by resolving routing and dispatching to the appropriate route.

classes.name: RouteRunner
classes.description: Handles the routing process for HTTP requests in the Slim framework, resolving routes and executing the associated route logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RouteRunner with the route resolver, parser, and optionally a route collector proxy.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main request handler that performs routing if not done, sets request attributes, and executes the matched route.
